name: BlzCreateFrameByType
case: typeName SIMPLEMESSAGEFRAME or CONTROL without its FDF fields, inherits ""
reason: crashes the game for every player, with no error: a frame of that type created without a template lacks the fields its FDF definition sets (jassdoc, BlzCreateSimpleFrame).
replacement: Inherit an FDF template that defines the type's fields: pass its name as inherits.
